LESSON: RHYTHM AND PATTERN MAKING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Creating and Executing
Topic 1.4: Rhythm and Pattern Making

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Rhythm and Pattern Making
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why create rhythm in different beat patterns?
